goal: 和快递员沟通找到包裹

n1.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n1.line: Hi, I am from Express Plus. I am sorry, but we cannot find your package. Where could it be?
n1.lineCn: 您好,我是速达快递的。很抱歉,我们找不到您的包裹了。它可能在哪儿呢?

grammar.name: 情态动词推测 where could it be
grammar.note: could 表推测,语气较弱,表示"有可能在哪儿"。

options.text: It might have been left at the front desk yesterday. Could you check there first?
options.textCn: 它可能昨天被放在前台了,您能先查查那儿吗?
options.feedback: 用 might have been 推测过去,还给出排查方向。
语气太肯定却没有依据,反而堵死线索。
不提供任何线索,快递员无从查起。

n2.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n2.line: We checked the front desk, but there is nothing there. Hmm, it could have been signed for by someone else. Did you get any notice?
n2.lineCn: 我们查了前台,但那里没有。嗯,它可能被其他人签收了。您收到过什么通知吗?

grammar.name: could have been 推测过去
grammar.note: could have + 过去分词,推测过去可能已经发生的动作。

options.text: Wait, it might be in the locker at the west gate. I often pick packages up there. Can you check that locker?
options.textCn: 等等,它可能在西门的快递柜里。我经常在那儿取件。您能查查那个柜子吗?
options.feedback: 提供具体地点线索,用 might be 合理推测。

options.text: No notice at all. You must be lying to me!
options.textCn: 什么通知都没有。你一定在骗我!
options.feedback: 无凭据指责快递员,沟通直接僵住。

n3.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n3.line: Take it easy. Let us think together. When did you last see the package? It might still be in our delivery station.
n3.lineCn: 别着急,我们一起想想。您最后一次看到包裹是什么时候?它可能还在我们的配送站。

grammar.name: might still be 推测现在
grammar.note: might + be 推测现在仍处于的状态,语气委婉。

options.text: I saw the tracking page last night, and it said the package was out for delivery. So it must be somewhere in this area now.
options.textCn: 昨晚我看过物流页,显示包裹正在派送。所以它现在一定在这附近某个地方。
options.feedback: 用 must be 做出有依据的推断,缩小搜索范围。

options.text: I have no idea. It could be anywhere on earth!
options.textCn: 我不知道,它可能在地球上任何地方!
options.feedback: 夸张却无效,快递员没法定位。

n4.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n4.line: Good news! We found a package in that locker that matches your number. But it might be for another customer. Can you describe the box?
n4.lineCn: 好消息!我们在那个柜子里找到了一个匹配您单号的包裹。但它可能是别人的。您能描述一下箱子吗?

grammar.name: might be 表不确定
grammar.note: might be 表示把握不高的推测:"可能是"别人的包裹。

options.text: It must be mine: a small brown box with a phone case inside. The tracking number can confirm it.
options.textCn: 那一定是我的:一个装手机壳的棕色小盒子。单号可以确认。
options.feedback: 用 must be 坚定判断,并提供核实方式。

options.text: I cannot describe it. It is a mystery box.
options.textCn: 我描述不了,它是个神秘盒子。
options.feedback: 连自己的包裹都说不清,无法确认归属。

n5.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n5.line: I understand you are upset, but accusing me will not help. Maybe the package was delivered to your neighbor's door. Shall we ask them?
n5.lineCn: 我理解您很着急,但指责我解决不了问题。也许包裹被送到了邻居家门口,我们问问他们好吗?

grammar.name: maybe + 推测
grammar.note: maybe 表示可能,常与情态动词连用表达不确定的推测。

options.text: You are right, sorry. The package might be at room 502, the neighbor who shares my name. Let us knock on their door.
options.textCn: 你说得对,抱歉。包裹可能在 502 室那位和我同名的邻居那里,我们去敲敲门吧。
options.feedback: 道歉并给出关键线索,推测合理。

options.text: No! It can't be there. You must go find it right now!
options.textCn: 不可能!你必须马上给我找回来!
options.feedback: 拒绝一切线索,只命令快递员,沟通失败。

n6.speaker: 快递员 Courier
n6.line: The number matches perfectly! This must be your package. I am so glad we found it. Anything else I can do for you?
n6.lineCn: 单号完全匹配!这一定是您的包裹。太高兴找到了。还有什么能帮您的吗?

grammar.name: must be 有依据的肯定推测
grammar.note: must + be 表示基于证据的肯定判断:"一定是"。

options.text: No, thanks! It couldn't be better. Have a nice day!
options.textCn: 没有了,谢谢!不能再好了,祝您愉快!
options.feedback: 确认包裹无误,满意收尾。

options.text: Are you sure? It might be wrong. I will not take it.
options.textCn: 你确定吗?也许搞错了,我不要了。
options.feedback: 单号都匹配了还拒收,快递员很无奈。

success.speaker: 快递员 Courier
success.line: Great! Enjoy your new phone case. Sorry for the trouble!
success.lineCn: 太好了!好好用新手机壳。给您添麻烦了,抱歉!

fail1.speaker: 快递员 Courier
fail1.line: Without more details, I am afraid we cannot locate it today. We will keep searching and call you back.
fail1.lineCn: 没有更多细节,恐怕今天很难找到。我们会继续查找并给您回电。

fail2.speaker: 快递员 Courier
fail2.line: Okay, I will do my best, but please cooperate with us. We are on the same side here.
fail2.lineCn: 好的,我会尽力,但也请您配合我们。我们是站在同一边的。
